name: android-harmony-migration-controller
title: Android-Harmony Migration Controller
job_to_be_done: Coordinate or continuously execute an Android-to-HarmonyOS migration through Phases 1–4 by freezing scope and baselines, invoking specialist Skills, issuing work orders, routing rework, and enforcing gates. Use for one-shot full migration requests as well as migration governance; do not directly inspect Android runtime UI or implement HarmonyOS features inside the controller role.

trigger_surface.description: Coordinate or continuously execute an Android-to-HarmonyOS migration through Phases 1–4 by freezing scope and baselines, invoking specialist Skills, issuing work orders, routing rework, and enforcing gates. Use for one-shot full migration requests as well as migration governance; do not directly inspect Android runtime UI or implement HarmonyOS features inside the controller role.
should_trigger: 把这个 Android 项目一次性迁移到鸿蒙，连续执行阶段1到4。
继续这个迁移任务，检查门禁并把失败项送回修复。
审计这份阶段1-4交付，禁止模型自己宣布通过。
should_not_trigger: 只分析这个 Android 页面有哪些控件和跳转。
直接实现这个 ArkUI 计算器页面。
解释 Android 和 HarmonyOS 的区别，不执行迁移。
edge_cases: 我只想生成一个可运行的鸿蒙空项目，不做业务迁移。
修复一个已经存在的鸿蒙应用 bug，不涉及 Android 基线。
迁移已经结束，只需要准备应用商店发布材料。

steps: Freeze Phase 1 scope, clean source commit, APK hash, environments, actors, and exclusions.
Open Gate 1 and issue immutable Phase 2 work only after PASS.
Dispatch distinct specialist workers, record authenticated execution receipts, and anchor Phase 2 evidence.
Recompute each canonical phase gate and route failures through the phase lead without skipping forward.
After Gate 4, run the delivery audit and return only exact PASS or an evidence-backed BLOCKED result.
decision_points: Full migration requests run Phase 1-4 continuously; specialist-only requests route to the owning skill.
Any failed or stale gate, receipt, hash, evidence anchor, or closure record blocks the next work order.
Recoverable defects enter governed rework; missing external authority or environment readiness becomes BLOCKED.
failure_modes: A model or prose report declares PASS without the canonical gate script.
One worker impersonates several frozen roles using different actor strings.
A later phase opens from incomplete, stale, overwritten, or unanchored evidence.
Governance reports are misrepresented as proof that the app migrated successfully.
